---
title: "Lock and Synchronize R Packages"
subtitle: "Keep project packages separate from the immutable runtime with uvr"
execute:
  eval: false
---

`uvr.toml` declares direct R package requirements and `uvr.lock` records their
resolved versions. Neither belongs in the SIF: the SIF provides the stable R
ABI; `.uvr/library` is project state, is ignored by Git, and is recreated with
`uvr sync --frozen` from the committed lockfile.

This declaration is migrated from the existing `rproject.toml` direct
dependencies. The vscode-R source was previously pinned because its `sess` package
resides in a repository subdirectory; we are trying to knock this out without
the high demands of vscode, so we're commenting it out for now. #TODO should we remove it entirely?

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-config-toml file="{{ emit.project_root }}/uvr.toml" title="Emit the uvr package declaration"}

r_version = "4.5.1"

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/.Rprofile" title="Emit R startup for the uvr library"}

```r
local({
  uvr_library <- Sys.getenv("UVR_LIBRARY", file.path(getwd(), ".uvr", "library"))
  uvr_library <- normalizePath(uvr_library, mustWork = FALSE)
  if (dir.exists(uvr_library)) {
    .libPaths(unique(c(uvr_library, .libPaths())))
  }
  Sys.setenv(R_LIBS_USER = uvr_library, R_LIBS = uvr_library)
})
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Lock and synchronize against the containerized R"}

```sh
scripts/kiribati-biomarkers uvr lock
scripts/kiribati-biomarkers uvr sync
scripts/kiribati-biomarkers uvr sync --frozen
```

Generate `uvr.lock` through the runner, review and commit it, then use
`uvr sync --frozen` for repeatable installations. This keeps lock resolution
and any source compilation aligned with the image's Spack R ABI and compiler.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify declaration shape without R"}

```sh
quarto render notebooks --profile emit --no-execute
test -f uvr.toml
rg -n '^r_version = "4.5.1"|^targets =|^\[dependencies\.vscode-R\]' uvr.toml
test -f uvr.lock
scripts/kiribati-biomarkers uvr sync --frozen
```
